# Embeddings Table Migration

This migration introduces support for storing vector embeddings in the database by enabling the 'pgvector' extension and creating an 'embeddings' table. It supports both applying the migration (upgrade) and rolling it back (downgrade), thus managing the data schema for embeddings generation and storage.
